text: This report was written to comply with the Council-approved Investment Policy and provides the following information: 1. General Market Update and Benchmark Performance 2. Performance of the Funds - for the period January 1, 2018 to March 31, 2018 3. Compliance - breakdown of the portfolio against the Investment Policy guidelines 4. Recommendations for Investment Policy Changes Fund returns to March 31 are in line with budget expectations, and the portfolio has remained compliant with the Investment Policy. Due to the 2018 City Council schedule, semi-annual updates will be provided in May and November in 2018. In subsequent years, this semi-annual report will be completed in the May/June period and in the August/September period to capture prior year-end and mid-year results.
